nodes.description: Private mapping of token balances per address in ERC20.
Private nested mapping of owner=>spender=>allowance in ERC20.
Private total token supply counter in ERC20.
Private token name string in TokenMintERC20Token.
Private token symbol string in TokenMintERC20Token.
Private token decimals value in TokenMintERC20Token.
totalSupply() public view returns _totalSupply.
balanceOf(address account) public view returns _balances[account].
transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public, moves msg.sender tokens.
allowance(address owner, address spender) public view returns stored allowance.
approve(address spender, uint256 value) public, sets allowance from msg.sender.
transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public, moves tokens and reduces allowance.
increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) public.
decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) public.
_transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) internal, updates balances.
_mint(address account, uint256 amount) internal, increases total supply and balance.
_burn(address account, uint256 value) internal, decreases total supply and balance.
_approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 value) internal, writes allowance.
_burnFrom(address account, uint256 amount) internal, burns and reduces caller allowance.
payable constructor setting metadata, minting supply and paying fee receiver.
burn(uint256 value) public, burns msg.sender tokens.
name() public view returns _name.
symbol() public view returns _symbol.
decimals() public view returns _decimals.
msg.sender, caller-controlled address used for transfer/approve/burn authorization.
feeReceiver.transfer(msg.value) external value call to an attacker-controllable address inside the payable constructor.
SafeMath sub/add arithmetic on _balances entries inside _transfer.
SafeMath add/sub arithmetic on _totalSupply inside _mint and _burn.
SafeMath sub arithmetic reducing allowance entries in transferFrom/_burnFrom.
recipient address parameter of transfer/transferFrom.
amount uint256 parameter of transfer/transferFrom/_burnFrom.
spender address parameter of approve/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance/allowance.
value uint256 parameter of approve/burn/_burn/_approve.
owner address parameter of allowance/_approve.
sender address parameter of transferFrom/_transfer.
account address parameter of balanceOf/_mint/_burn/_burnFrom.
addedValue uint256 parameter of increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue uint256 parameter of decreaseAllowance.
name string parameter of the constructor.
symbol string parameter of the constructor.
decimals uint8 parameter of the constructor.
totalSupply uint256 parameter of the constructor.
feeReceiver payable address parameter of the constructor receiving msg.value.
tokenOwnerAddress parameter of the constructor receiving the minted supply.

edges.reason: totalSupply() reads the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf() reads the _balances mapping for the given account.
allowance() reads the _allowances nested mapping.
transfer() delegates balance mutation to the internal _transfer().
approve() delegates allowance writing to the internal _approve().
transferFrom() first calls _transfer() to move tokens.
transferFrom() calls _approve() to reduce the spender allowance.
increaseAllowance() calls _approve() with the incremented allowance.
decreaseAllowance() calls _approve() with the decremented allowance.
_burnFrom() calls _burn() to destroy tokens from the account.
_burnFrom() calls _approve() to deduct the caller allowance.
constructor mints the entire supply via _mint().
constructor performs an external value transfer to the attacker-influenced feeReceiver address, enabling reentrant calls back into the contract.
burn() calls the internal _burn() with msg.sender as account.
_transfer() reads and writes _balances for sender and recipient.
_transfer() performs SafeMath sub/add arithmetic on balance values.
_mint() performs SafeMath add arithmetic on _totalSupply and balance values.
_burn() performs SafeMath sub arithmetic on _totalSupply and balance values.
_mint() increases the _totalSupply state variable.
_mint() credits the _balances mapping of the target account.
_burn() decreases the _totalSupply state variable.
_burn() debits the _balances mapping of the target account.
_approve() writes the _allowances nested mapping.
_burnFrom() reads and reduces the _allowances entry for the caller.
transferFrom() performs SafeMath sub on the allowance of sender/msg.sender.
_burnFrom() performs SafeMath sub on the allowance of account/msg.sender.
name() returns the _name state variable.
symbol() returns the _symbol state variable.
decimals() returns the _decimals state variable.
transfer() derives the debited account directly from the caller-controlled msg.sender.
approve() grants allowance on behalf of the caller-controlled msg.sender.
_transfer() receives msg.sender as the sender argument, so caller identity governs the debit.
_approve() uses msg.sender as owner/spender, letting the caller mutate allowances.
_burn() uses msg.sender as the account being burned.
_burnFrom() uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is deducted.
burn() burns tokens from the caller-controlled msg.sender.
recipient parameter flows into transfer().
recipient parameter flows into _transfer() to select the credited account.
amount parameter flows into transfer().
amount parameter flows into transferFrom().
amount parameter flows into _transfer() arithmetic.
amount parameter flows into _burnFrom().
spender parameter flows into approve().
spender parameter flows into increaseAllowance().
spender parameter flows into decreaseAllowance().
spender parameter flows into _approve().
value parameter flows into approve().
value parameter flows into _burn() arithmetic.
value parameter flows into _approve().
value parameter flows into burn().
owner parameter flows into allowance().
owner parameter flows into _approve().
sender parameter flows into transferFrom().
sender parameter flows into _transfer().
account parameter flows into balanceOf().
account parameter flows into _mint().
account parameter flows into _burn().
account parameter flows into _burnFrom().
addedValue parameter flows into increaseAllowance() arithmetic.
subtractedValue parameter flows into decreaseAllowance() arithmetic.
name parameter is stored into _name by the constructor.
symbol parameter is stored into _symbol by the constructor.
decimals parameter is stored into _decimals by the constructor.
totalSupply parameter is minted by the constructor.
feeReceiver parameter is the destination of the external value transfer, making the call target attacker-controlled.
tokenOwnerAddress parameter is passed to _mint() as the credited account.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is only a transient address argument used to select the credited balance inside _transfer().
amount is only a transient value argument consumed by the SafeMath arithmetic in _transfer().
spender is only a transient address argument used when writing the allowance in _approve().
value is only a transient value argument consumed by the subtraction arithmetic in _burn().
owner is only a transient address argument used as the allowance owner in _approve().
sender is only a transient address argument used as the debited balance holder in _transfer().
account is only a transient address argument used as the credited balance holder in _mint().
addedValue is only a transient value argument consumed by the addition in increaseAllowance().
subtractedValue is only a transient value argument consumed by the subtraction in decreaseAllowance().
name is only a transient construction argument stored into _name by the constructor.
symbol is only a transient construction argument stored into _symbol by the constructor.
decimals is only a transient construction argument stored into _decimals by the constructor.
totalSupply is only a transient construction argument forwarded to _mint() by the constructor.
feeReceiver is only a transient construction argument that becomes the target of the external fee transfer.
tokenOwnerAddress is only a transient construction argument forwarded to _mint() as the recipient.
